dependency-layer-order.description: Intra-layer ordering offset added to dependency-layer's base sync-wave (t33). Required to be a positive integer whenever `dependencies` includes an app in the SAME dependency-layer — app-factory.validate rejects a same-layer edge without it, since without a real wave difference ArgoCD applies both apps concurrently and the edge is documentation, not ordering. app-factory.syncwave rejects a value that reaches the next layer's base.

sources.description: ArgoCD multi-source list. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

finalizer.description: Add resources-finalizer so deleting the Application cascade-deletes its resources.

namespace.description: Destination namespace (consumed by the catalogue, not by app-factory.application).

ignoreDifferences.description: ArgoCD ignoreDifferences, for charts whose rendered empty collections are stripped by the API server.

annotations.description: Extra Application metadata.annotations, rendered after the factory's own. Values must be strings: an unquoted number renders as a YAML int and the API server rejects the object. Keys the factory derives (argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave, kapp.k14s.io/change-*, platform.pnats.cloud/*) are rejected rather than overwritten. Needed for ArgoCD settings that exist only as annotations, e.g. argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: ServerSideDiff=true.
